content.value: The force and displacement of a simple dynamic system undergoing sinusoidal excitation are given by the equations F = 11sin N, and Y = 2sin $( { \frac { \pi t } { 6 } } - { \frac { \pi } { 4 } } )$ meters. Calculate the work done by the excitation force in (i) 24 seconds and (ii) 5 days.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 1st Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2023
